subject: The main thing
author: Linkster
body:
I would like to see is the showtimes being scrapped and replaced with the crash junctions that were in Point Of Impact.  I find the showtimes incredibly dull and get bored of them easily.

I like the new checkpoints that are in BSI so they should be a must and also put more emphasis on racing.  To keep the stunt fans happy how about bringing in ATVs and for those who are fans of smashing stuff up trucks.  Basically what I'm saying is Fuel but a lot better 😃

subject: Better to start from scratch...
author: ZombieTron
body:
I think a Paradise 2 would be able to be a better game then if they just keep updating this version. I'm sure it would be easier for them to do chevron checkpoints etc if they are building the game from scratch and not being constrained by the current disc content.

Although I think if they want to add a 2nd city as DLC for cheaper then a full game, as there wont be the manufacturing costs, I wouldn't be complaining. As long as it was a new improved city with all that they have learned over the past couple of years. The only problem with this is that I would probably need to get a bigger hard drive! Can you imagine the size of the DL!!??

subject: Why bother with a 2
author: SUFFUR
body:
When they could update the whole of Paradise for the price of a whole new game, as a DL, so 4200 MSP, and we will get a new and Improved Paradise and have an old Island, we also need to give them a Year to do so, I can't wait!

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?

subject: Pursuit
author: guzbristow
body:
I'm a great fan of the pursuits in BO2, this could be expanded and made harder by introducing  tag / relay events.

The Eliminating races were also good events in BO4.  Id like to see off road and multi rider bike events. How about a demolition derby event around the base ball ground near to silver lake?

As BOP has expanded into motorbikes how about racing boats just off the island ? lol

Just a newbies thoughts.

Guz

subject: Main things in Paradise 2.
author: jwillisjr
body:
Let's assume that Burnout will get massive like World of war craft.... 

 

They would need to add more islands and then go onto many other countries and fly their like Burnout 3 take down. 

We need an Airport that we can park our car in while we jetset to another country. US, to UK, to Asia. Simple as that.

oh also we need to be able to smash through some  glass windows in buildings.  But wait...does that make it paradise 2? lol.
